blocks.text:
●本商品の対象年齢は15才以上です。 対象年齢未満のお子様には絶対に与えないでください。 ●小さな部品、電池がありますので、小さなお子様が誤って飲み込まな
いように注意してください。 窒息などの危険があります。 ●耳の近くで使用してはいけません。 誤って使用すると、聴覚を損なう恐れがあります。●本商品には電子部品を
使用しております。また電波を発信しますので、ペースメーカーをご使用の方はご注意ください。 ●可動部には指などを入れないでください。はさまれてケガをする恐れがあ
ります。LEDの光の点滅を見続けないでください。気分が悪くなったりする恐れがあります。 《電池を誤使用すると発熱・破裂・液もれの恐れがあります。 下記に注意して
ください》●万一、電池から漏れた液が目に入ったときはすぐに大量の水で洗い、医師に相談してください。 皮膚や服に付いた時は水で洗ってください。 二次電池(充
電式電池) は、絶対に使用しないでください。 ●古い電池と新しい電池、いろいろな種類の電池をまぜて使わないでください。●+一(プラスマイナス)を正しくセットしてく
ださい。 ●遊んだ後は必ずスイッチを切り電池をはずしてください。 電池を入れたままにしておくと、液漏れの恐れがあり危険です。ショートさせたり充電、分解、加熱、 火
の中に入れたりしないでください。 ●廃棄するときは、自治体の廃棄処理の指示に従ってください。
blocks.translation:
• The target age for this product is 15 years and older. Do not give it to children under that age.
• This product contains small parts and batteries; keep it away from small children so they do not swallow them. There is a risk of choking.
• Do not use this product near the ear. Improper use may damage hearing.
• This product contains electronic components and transmits radio waves; people using pacemakers should take care.
• Do not put fingers or other objects into moving parts. They may become pinched and cause injury.
• Do not stare at the flashing LED light. It may cause nausea or other discomfort.
• Incorrect battery use may cause heating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following precautions.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, immediately rinse thoroughly with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If fluid gets on skin or clothing, wash with water.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert batteries with the correct +/− polarity.
• Always turn the switch off and remove the batteries after playing. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or put batteries into fire.
• When disposing of this product, follow your local municipality's disposal instructions.

blocks.text:
<使用上の注意> ●本商品は精密に作られています。無理な力を加えたり、落としたりすると破損するおそれがあります。 本商品は精密な電子部品で構成されていま
す。落としたり、水にぬらしたり、汚したり、分解したりしないでください。また、高温・低温になる所での使用、保管はさけてください。 本商品を樹脂製のソファーやシート、タ
イルなどの上に置かないでください。 長時間接触していると色が移る場合があります。 ●可動部分・取付部分を無理な方向に強く引っ張ったり、曲げたりしないでください。
●発音の一部にイントネーションが違っていたり、 商品の特性上聞き取りにくいものがありますが、ご了承ください。 ●梱包材に戻して商品を保管する際は、必ず袋に入れ
てください。商品の特性上、外観のばらつきがございます。 予めご了承ください。
blocks.translation:
• Precautions for Use
• This product is precisely made. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• This product contains delicate electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it where temperatures become very high or very low.
• Do not place this product on resin sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
• Do not strongly pull or bend moving parts or attachment parts in unnatural directions.
• Some spoken lines may have different intonation or may be hard to hear because of the product's characteristics.
• When returning the product to its packaging for storage, always put it in a bag.
• Because of the product's characteristics, the appearance may vary.

blocks.text: 台詞リスト <ベルト装着前状態>
blocks.translation: Line list <Before the belt is worn>

blocks.text: モモタロス
台詞一覧
二度と一人で戦うなんて言うな。いいな!
blocks.translation: Don't ever say you'll fight alone again. Got it!

blocks.text: うるせえハナくそ女! ・・・どわあっ!
上等じゃねえか。 迷う必要なんかねえよ。 消えるとか消えねえとか、そんなのは後の話だ。
blocks.translation:
• That's perfect.
• There's no need to hesitate.
• Whether it disappears or not is something to deal with later.

blocks.text: つあーもう･･･ごめんなさーーーい!
俺が暴れたいってのもホントだしな。
blocks.translation: It's true that I want to go on a rampage, too.

blocks.text:
おい良太郎。 お前へなちょこかと思ってたが、結構頑固で根性あるじゃねえか。
え?まあモモタロスってのはセンスねえけど、センスねえよな。
blocks.translation:
• Hey Ryotaro. I thought you were a weakling, but you're pretty stubborn and you've got guts, huh.
• Huh? Well, Momotaros has no sense — he really has no sense, right?

blocks.text: ただ･･･、まあ・・・、ちょっとでも守りたいと思うとしたらよ・・・、 今ってやつだ。
blocks.translation: It's just... well, if there's even a little thing you want to protect, it's the present—right now.

blocks.text: つーか、お前運悪いからな、消えるとか言う前に腐った頭でも食ってよ、
blocks.translation: Seriously, you're just unlucky — before you tell me to disappear, go eat a rotten head.

blocks.text:
センスねえけど、呼びたきゃ勝手に呼べよ。
楽しそうだな! 俺も遊ばせてくれ。
blocks.translation:
• I'm no good with style, but if you want to call, go ahead and call.
• That looks fun! Let me play too.

blocks.text: ポックリかもしれねえ。 そしたら、俺も道連れだ。 多分、亀公たちもそう思ってるぜ。
blocks.translation:
• I might suddenly croak (drop dead).
• If that happens, I'll take others with me.
• They probably think the same.

blocks.text: だから、戦わせろよ。 良太郎。 な。 ほら立てよ。 亀公たちが負けちまうぞ。
blocks.translation: So let him fight, Ryotaro. Come on. Hey, get up. Kamekō and the others will lose.

blocks.text:
|大サービスで見せてやるから、よく見とけ。
良太郎、ボサっとすんな! 裏打ち行こうぜ!
俺の必殺技、 モモタロスパージョン!
blocks.translation:
• I'll put on a big show, so watch closely.
• Ryotaro, don't zone out! Here comes the main act!
• My finishing move: Momotaros Version!

blocks.text: また会おうぜー!
デンライナー署、出動だ!

別れるのも消えるのも一緒だろ! わねえ!いいか、俺はな、かっこよく戦えればそれで
いいんだよ! 俺達の時間がどうとか消えるとか、そんなものに興味はねえ!
blocks.translation: Separating and disappearing are the same, aren't they? They're no different! Listen, for me, if I can fight in a cool way, that's enough! I don't care about our time or disappearing or things like that!

blocks.text:
幸太郎、もしお前が言うみてえに時代が変わるならよ、こいつは俺最後のクライマックスだ。
邪魔すんじゃねえ。 な。てめえらいいな!
blocks.translation:
• Koutarou, if the era really does change like you say, this is my final climax.
• Don't get in my way. Got that, you bastards!

blocks.text: ウラタロス
台詞一覽
気を付けた方がいいよ。 言葉の裏には針千本。千の偽り万の嘘。
blocks.translation: Be careful. Behind words lie a thousand needles. A thousand deceits and ten thousand lies.

blocks.text: 僕がかっこいいのは生まれつき。
それでもいいなら、僕に釣られてみる?
blocks.translation: If that's all right, do you want to try being lured by me?

blocks.text: ちゃんと嘘を教えられなくて、ごめんね、良太郎。
blocks.translation: I'm sorry I couldn't properly teach you how to lie, Ryotaro.

blocks.text: まいったな。 結平気だったはずなんだけど。
blocks.translation: Ugh. I thought I was pretty okay, though.

blocks.text:
良太郎、僕の嘘を安っぽく解釈されるのは許せないよ。僕のはの為の嘘なんだから。
でも、僕が泳げるのは嘘じゃない。 ボタン押せばいいんじゃないの? 死なれたら僕も困る。
blocks.translation:
• Ryotaro, I won't tolerate my lies being written off as cheap.
• My lies are lies for the sake of lying.
• But it's not a lie that I can swim.
• Couldn't you just press the button? If he dies, I'll be in trouble too.

blocks.text: お前たちには感謝してんだよねぇ。 これ以上、あっちにいたら、
blocks.translation: I'm grateful to you guys, you know. If I stayed over there any longer—

blocks.text: クールでカッコイイ僕じゃ、いられなくなりそうだったから。 僕、泣きしかしたことないし。
blocks.translation: Because I felt like I might no longer be the cool, handsome me. I've only ever cried.

blocks.text: 時間を手に入れるのも、良し悪しだよね。
blocks.translation: Getting extra time has its pros and cons.

blocks.text: 慌てる漁師に魚は釣れない。
blocks.translation: A panicked fisherman won't catch any fish.

blocks.text: 今夜は、僕に釣られてみる?
blocks.translation: Want to be caught by me tonight?

blocks.text: じゃあね。
キンタロス
台詞一覧
良太郎はめちゃめちゃ強いやないか! 俺が消えそうになったとき、 自分とこに入れて
blocks.translation: Ryotaro is ridiculously strong, isn't he! When I was about to disappear, he pulled me into himself.

blocks.text: 強さにもランクがあってな、俺の強さは、泣けるでえ。 涙はこれで拭いとけ。
blocks.translation:
• Strength has ranks, and my strength will make you cry.
• Wipe your tears with this.

blocks.text: くれたやろ。 普通、怖くてそんなんできへん。 俺も無理や。 大体、強なかったら
blocks.translation:
• They gave it to me, didn't they.
• Normally you'd be too scared to do something like that.
• I couldn't either.
• Besides, if it wasn't strong...

blocks.text: ほんまにええんか･･･。 おおきに!
blocks.translation:
• Are you really okay with this...?
• Thanks!

blocks.text: ぐぉー
(いびき)
あのモモの字たちがおとなしく悪いとらんで。どう見ても、強い思うけどなあ。あかんのか?
blocks.translation: Those Momo characters aren't being quiet. No matter how you look at them, they seem strong. Is that a problem?

blocks.text: あんな、良太郎がどう言おうと、俺は闘いをやめる気はないで。
blocks.translation: No matter what Ryotaro says, I have no intention of stopping the fight.

blocks.text: いなくなる? なくなる? 泣く?・・・泣けるで!
blocks.translation: Disappear? Be gone? Cry? ...It'll make you cry!

blocks.text: 俺の命はとっくに良太郎に預けとる。
blocks.translation: I've long since entrusted my life to Ryotaro.

blocks.text: 投げない? 泣けない? 泣けない!? ･･･泣けるで!
blocks.translation: Not throwing it? Can't cry? Can't cry!? ...You'll cry!

blocks.text: 亡き者、 なき、 なき! ・・・泣けるで!
blocks.translation: The dead—cry, cry! ...It makes you want to cry!

blocks.text: おおきに。
負ける? 泣ける?・・・泣けるで!
ほんなら本番いこか。 俺の強さにお前がわろた! あかん、しまらんのお。
blocks.translation:
• Alright then, let's do this for real.
• You laughed at my strength!
• Oh no — it's out of control.

blocks.text: 心の涙は、 これでは拭かれへん!
blocks.translation: This won't wipe away the tears in my heart!

blocks.text: 俺の強さはぁ、やっぱ泣けるで!
blocks.translation: My strength—after all, it really makes people cry!

blocks.text: 俺の、強さに、お前が、泣いた! ぐぉー――(いびき )
blocks.translation: You cried at my strength! Gwooo— (snoring)

blocks.text: リュウタロス
台詞一覧
あたたた、ハナちゃんに殴られた･･･。
blocks.translation: Ouch... I got hit by Hana-chan.

blocks.text: あ、リュウタロスでいいんだよね?
お前、嫌いだ。
お姉ちゃんだ。 お姉ちゃん!
お前ほんとにうるさいし嫌い。 やってもいいよね。 答えは聞いてない。
blocks.translation:
• You're really loud and I hate you.
• You can go ahead and do it, right?
• I'm not asking for your answer.

blocks.text: うるさいよ。 モモタロスは黙っててよ。
ごめんな･･･さい・・・。
お姉ちゃん。 僕を好きになってよ。 強くなるから。
blocks.translation:
• Big sister.
• Fall in love with me.
• I'll become stronger.

blocks.text: モモタロスの、ばーか! ばーかばーか!
僕お前やっつけて強くなるよ。
blocks.translation: I'll beat you and get stronger.

blocks.text: 楽しかったよね? 答えは聞いてない!
blocks.translation: That was fun, wasn't it? I didn't ask for your answer!

blocks.text: いいよね?
お前たち、逮捕するけどいいよね? 答えは聞いてない。
blocks.translation:
• I'm arresting you—okay?
• I'm not asking for an answer.

blocks.text: ネガタロス
※<ネガ竜王状態>で赤スイッチを押します。
blocks.translation: In <Nega Ryuou state>, press the red switch.

blocks.text: 台詞一覧
餌とも知らねえで、バカな奴らだ。
blocks.translation: They don't even know they're bait. What idiots.

blocks.text: バカ野郎! 最後に絶対負けるようなのと一緒にすんじゃねえよ。
blocks.translation: You idiot! Don't stick with someone who's definitely going to lose in the end.

blocks.text: まずここを破壊だ。 悪の組織の第一歩としちゃ、これ程似合う打ち上げ花火はねえだろう。
blocks.translation:
• First, destroy this place.
• As the first step for an evil organization, there couldn't be a more fitting fireworks display than this.

blocks.text: これからが悪の組織の本番なんだ。 これ以上揉めるっていうなら、お前らを、消すぜ。
blocks.translation: This is when the evil organization really gets started. If you cause any more trouble, I'll wipe you out.

blocks.text: お前ら・・・生きてたのか!
明日には人間どもが皆、 俺様の前にひれ伏すことになる。
blocks.translation: Tomorrow, all humans will kneel before me.

blocks.text: お前らは只の前座だ。 さっさと死んでもらおう。
blocks.translation:
• You're just the opening act.
• Hurry up and die.

blocks.text: お前の望みを言え。 どんな望みも叶えてやろう。 お前が払う代償はたったひとつ。
blocks.translation: Tell me your wish. I'll grant any wish. There's only one price you'll pay.

blocks.text: お前の望み、聞いたぜ。
欲しいもの?愛かな。
blocks.translation: What do you want? Maybe love.

blocks.text: 10 さあね、僕はキンちゃんみたいな浪花節は似合わないから。
blocks.translation: 10 Hmm, I don't know — a melodramatic style like Kin-chan's doesn't suit me.

blocks.text: 人生を面白くするのは、千の真実より一つのだよ。
blocks.translation: What makes life interesting is one lie more than a thousand truths.

blocks.text: す
誤魔化して嘘ついて偽ってこその人生だよ。 良太郎にそれを教えるのが、僕の役目だ。
blocks.translation: Life is about deceiving, lying, and pretending. It's my role to teach that to Ryotaro.

blocks.text: 7 魚心あれば水心あり、だね。
blocks.translation: 7 If the fish is willing, the water will be too.

blocks.text: 1 いきがるだけの強さなら俺には勝たれへん。
blocks.translation: 1 If it's just showy strength, you can't beat me.

blocks.text: 戻って戦うんや! お前は強い! 良太郎! 早よ行かんか!
blocks.translation: Go back and fight! You're strong! Ryotaro! Hurry up and go!

blocks.text: ほんまやったら、ずっと前に消えとったはずや。 いさしてくれて、おおきに。
blocks.translation: If it had been true, I would have disappeared long ago. Thanks for letting me stay.

blocks.text: 1 僕のこと、好きになってくれるよね。
blocks.translation: 1 You'll come to like me, won't you?

blocks.text: 俺様は誰も作ったことのねえ究極の悪の組織ってやつを、ぶちあげる。
blocks.translation: I'm going to launch the ultimate evil organization no one has ever made before.

blocks.text: これが、勝つ悪の組織ってやつだ。
blocks.translation: This is what a victorious evil organization looks like.

blocks.text: 3 俺のは正真正銘、勝利する悪の組織ネガタロス軍団! かっこ仮かっこ閉じってとこだ。
blocks.translation: 3 Mine is the genuine victorious evil organization — the Negataros Army!

source_blocks.text: 台詞リスト <ベルト装着前状態>
source_blocks.translation: Line list <Before the belt is worn>

source_blocks.text: お前の望みを言え。 どんな望みも叶えてやろう。 お前が払う代償はたったひとつ。
source_blocks.translation: Tell me your wish. I'll grant any wish. There's only one price you'll pay.

source_blocks.text: 二度と一人で戦うなんて言うな。いいな!
source_blocks.translation: Don't ever say you'll fight alone again. Got it?

source_blocks.text: うるせえハナくそ女! ・・・どわあっ!
source_blocks.translation: Shut up, you snotty woman, Hana! ...Whoa!

source_blocks.text: 上等じゃねえか。 迷う必要なんかねえよ。 消えるとか消えねえとか、そんなのは後の話だ。
source_blocks.translation: Fine by me. There's no need to hesitate. Whether we disappear or not is a matter for later.

source_blocks.text: つあーもう･･･ごめんなさーーーい!
俺が暴れたいってのもホントだしな。
source_blocks.translation: It's true I want to go on a rampage.

source_blocks.text:
おい良太郎。 お前へなちょこかと思ってたが、結構頑固で根性あるじゃねえか。
え?まあモモタロスってのはセンスねえけど、センスねえよな。
source_blocks.translation: Hey, Ryotaro. I thought you were a weakling, but you're pretty stubborn and you've got guts. Huh? Well, "Momotaros" sure has no sense — no sense at all.

source_blocks.text: ただ･･･、まあ・・・、ちょっとでも守りたいと思うとしたらよ・・・、 今ってやつだ。
source_blocks.translation: But... well... if there's even a bit you want to protect, then now's the time.

source_blocks.text: つーか、お前運悪いからな、消えるとか言う前に腐った頭でも食ってよ、
source_blocks.translation: Honestly, you're unlucky — before you start saying you'll disappear, go eat a rotten head.

source_blocks.text:
センスねえけど、呼びたきゃ勝手に呼べよ。
楽しそうだな! 俺も遊ばせてくれ。
source_blocks.translation: It lacks style, but if you want to call me that, suit yourself. Looks fun! Let me play too.

source_blocks.text: ポックリかもしれねえ。 そしたら、俺も道連れだ。 多分、亀公たちもそう思ってるぜ。
source_blocks.translation: He might just drop dead. If that happens, I'll go with him. Kamekō and the others probably feel the same.

source_blocks.text: だから、戦わせろよ。 良太郎。 な。 ほら立てよ。 亀公たちが負けちまうぞ。
source_blocks.translation: So let me fight, Ryotaro. Come on. Get up. Kamekō and the others will lose.

source_blocks.text:
|大サービスで見せてやるから、よく見とけ。
良太郎、ボサっとすんな! 裏打ち行こうぜ!
俺の必殺技、 モモタロスパージョン!
source_blocks.translation: I'll give you a great show, so watch closely. Ryotaro, don't just stand there! Let's strike from behind! My finishing move, "Momotaros Version!"

source_blocks.text: デンライナー署、出動だ!

別れるのも消えるのも一緒だろ! わねえ!いいか、俺はな、かっこよく戦えればそれで
いいんだよ! 俺達の時間がどうとか消えるとか、そんなものに興味はねえ!
source_blocks.translation: Breaking up and disappearing are the same thing! Right! Listen — for me, as long as I can fight in a cool way, that's enough! I'm not interested in things like our time together or disappearing!

source_blocks.text:
幸太郎、もしお前が言うみてえに時代が変わるならよ、こいつは俺最後のクライマックスだ。
邪魔すんじゃねえ。 な。てめえらいいな!
source_blocks.translation: Kotaro, if the era really does change like you say, this will be my final climax. Don't get in the way. Got it? You lot — listen up!

source_blocks.text: 気を付けた方がいいよ。 言葉の裏には針千本。千の偽り万の嘘。
source_blocks.translation: Be careful. Behind words lie a thousand needles — a thousand falsities, ten thousand lies.

source_blocks.text: 僕がかっこいいのは生まれつき。
それでもいいなら、僕に釣られてみる?
source_blocks.translation: If that's okay with you, want to try being lured by me?

source_blocks.text: ちゃんと嘘を教えられなくて、ごめんね、良太郎。
source_blocks.translation: Sorry I couldn't properly teach you how to lie, Ryotaro.
What do you want? Maybe love.

source_blocks.text: 10 さあね、僕はキンちゃんみたいな浪花節は似合わないから。
source_blocks.translation: 10 Hmm, I don't know — a melodramatic style like Kin-chan's doesn't suit me.

source_blocks.text: 人生を面白くするのは、千の真実より一つのだよ。
source_blocks.translation: What makes life interesting is one lie more than a thousand truths.

source_blocks.text: まいったな。 結平気だったはずなんだけど。
source_blocks.translation: Oh man... I thought I was fine, though.

source_blocks.text:
良太郎、僕の嘘を安っぽく解釈されるのは許せないよ。僕のはの為の嘘なんだから。
でも、僕が泳げるのは嘘じゃない。 ボタン押せばいいんじゃないの? 死なれたら僕も困る。
source_blocks.translation: Ryotaro, I can't forgive you for taking my lie so cheaply. My lies are meant for someone. But it's not a lie that I can swim. Can't you just press the button? If you died, I'd be in trouble too.

source_blocks.text: お前たちには感謝してんだよねぇ。 これ以上、あっちにいたら、
source_blocks.translation: I'm grateful to you guys. If I had stayed over there any longer...

source_blocks.text: クールでカッコイイ僕じゃ、いられなくなりそうだったから。 僕、泣きしかしたことないし。
source_blocks.translation: I felt like I couldn't remain the cool, stylish me anymore. I've only ever cried.

source_blocks.text: 誤魔化して嘘ついて偽ってこその人生だよ。 良太郎にそれを教えるのが、僕の役目だ。
source_blocks.translation: Life is about deceiving, lying, and pretending. It's my role to teach that to Ryotaro.

source_blocks.text: 時間を手に入れるのも、良し悪しだよね。
source_blocks.translation: There are ups and downs to gaining time, aren't there?

source_blocks.text: 慌てる漁師に魚は釣れない。
source_blocks.translation: A hurried fisherman won't catch any fish.

source_blocks.text: 今夜は、僕に釣られてみる?
source_blocks.translation: Want to try being caught by me tonight?

source_blocks.text: 7 魚心あれば水心あり、だね。
source_blocks.translation: 7 If the fish is willing, the water will be too.

source_blocks.text: 1 いきがるだけの強さなら俺には勝たれへん。
source_blocks.translation: 1 If it's just showy strength, you can't beat me.

source_blocks.text: 良太郎はめちゃめちゃ強いやないか! 俺が消えそうになったとき、 自分とこに入れて
source_blocks.translation: Ryotaro's ridiculously strong, isn't he! When I was about to disappear, he let me in.

source_blocks.text: 強さにもランクがあってな、俺の強さは、泣けるでえ。 涙はこれで拭いとけ。
source_blocks.translation: Strength comes in ranks, and my strength will make you cry. Use this to wipe your tears.

source_blocks.text: くれたやろ。 普通、怖くてそんなんできへん。 俺も無理や。 大体、強なかったら
source_blocks.translation: You gave it to me, right? Normally you'd be too scared to do that. I couldn't either. Generally, if you weren't strong...

source_blocks.text: ほんまにええんか･･･。 おおきに!
あのモモの字たちがおとなしく悪いとらんで。どう見ても、強い思うけどなあ。あかんのか?
source_blocks.translation: Those Momotaros guys aren't quietly being bad. No matter how you look at it, they seem strong. Is that no good?

source_blocks.text: あんな、良太郎がどう言おうと、俺は闘いをやめる気はないで。
source_blocks.translation: No matter what Ryotaro says, I have no intention of giving up fighting.

source_blocks.text: いなくなる? なくなる? 泣く?・・・泣けるで!
source_blocks.translation: Disappear? Be gone? Cry?... It'll make you cry!

source_blocks.text: 俺の命はとっくに良太郎に預けとる。
source_blocks.translation: I've already entrusted my life to Ryotaro.

source_blocks.text: 投げない? 泣けない? 泣けない!? ･･･泣けるで!
source_blocks.translation: Won't throw? Can't cry? Can't cry!? ...You will cry!

source_blocks.text: 戻って戦うんや! お前は強い! 良太郎! 早よ行かんか!
source_blocks.translation: Go back and fight! You're strong! Ryotaro! Hurry up and go!

source_blocks.text: 亡き者、 なき、 なき! ・・・泣けるで!
source_blocks.translation: Dead, dead, dead!...It makes me cry!

source_blocks.text: 負ける? 泣ける?・・・泣けるで!
ほんなら本番いこか。 俺の強さにお前がわろた! あかん、しまらんのお。
source_blocks.translation: Alright then, let's get to the real thing. You laughed at my strength! Oh no, this is a mess.

source_blocks.text: 心の涙は、 これでは拭かれへん!
source_blocks.translation: This won't wipe away the tears in my heart!

source_blocks.text: 俺の強さはぁ、やっぱ泣けるで!
source_blocks.translation: My strength really makes people cry!

source_blocks.text: ほんまやったら、ずっと前に消えとったはずや。 いさしてくれて、おおきに。
source_blocks.translation: If it had been true, I would have disappeared long ago. Thanks for letting me stay.

source_blocks.text: 俺の、強さに、お前が、泣いた! ぐぉー――(いびき )
source_blocks.translation: You cried because of my strength! Grrr――(snore)

source_blocks.text: 1 僕のこと、好きになってくれるよね。
source_blocks.translation: 1 You'll come to like me, won't you?

source_blocks.text: あ、リュウタロスでいいんだよね?
お姉ちゃんだ。 お姉ちゃん!
うるさいよ。 モモタロスは黙っててよ。
お姉ちゃん。 僕を好きになってよ。 強くなるから。
source_blocks.translation: Sis, please like me. I'll get stronger.

source_blocks.text: 僕お前やっつけて強くなるよ。
source_blocks.translation: I'll beat you and become stronger.

source_blocks.text: あたたた、ハナちゃんに殴られた･･･。
お前ほんとにうるさいし嫌い。 やってもいいよね。 答えは聞いてない。
source_blocks.translation: I really hate you — you're so noisy. It's okay if I do it, right? I'm not asking for an answer.

source_blocks.text: モモタロスの、ばーか! ばーかばーか!
楽しかったよね? 答えは聞いてない!
source_blocks.translation: That was fun, right? I didn't ask for an answer!

source_blocks.text: お前たち、逮捕するけどいいよね? 答えは聞いてない。
source_blocks.translation: I'm going to arrest you guys — is that okay? I didn't ask for your answer.

source_blocks.translation: *Press the red switch while in <Nega-Ryuuō state>.

source_blocks.translation: I'm going to launch the ultimate evil organization no one has ever made before.

source_blocks.text: 餌とも知らねえで、バカな奴らだ。
source_blocks.translation: They're fools who don't even realize they're bait.

source_blocks.text: バカ野郎! 最後に絶対負けるようなのと一緒にすんじゃねえよ。
source_blocks.translation: You idiot! Don't lump me in with people who are sure to lose in the end.

source_blocks.text: これが、勝つ悪の組織ってやつだ。
source_blocks.translation: This is what a victorious evil organization looks like.

source_blocks.text: 3 俺のは正真正銘、勝利する悪の組織ネガタロス軍団! かっこ仮かっこ閉じってとこだ。
source_blocks.translation: 3 Mine is the genuine victorious evil organization — the Negataros Army!

source_blocks.translation: First, destroy this place. As the first step of an evil organization, there's no better fireworks display than this.

source_blocks.text: これからが悪の組織の本番なんだ。 これ以上揉めるっていうなら、お前らを、消すぜ。
source_blocks.translation: Now the evil organization's real show begins. If you keep causing trouble, I'll erase you.

明日には人間どもが皆、 俺様の前にひれ伏すことになる。
source_blocks.translation: By tomorrow, all humans will be bowing before me.

source_blocks.translation: You lot are just opening acts. Hurry up and die.

uncertainties: The scanned first character appears as 'つ' but likely is 'あ' in context; reconstructed as 'あーもう…'.
The original elongation of 'ごめんなさい' is preserved as 'ごめんなさーーーい!'.
First word: image/OCR shows ボックリ or ポックリ — exact kana is unclear.
Second sentence: OCR showed 俺達も but source_text has 俺も — unclear whether singular or plural (I'll vs we'll).
第三文: 亀公たち — unclear whether this is a nickname/name (Kamekō) or literally 'old turtles'; subject identity is uncertain.
Second line: the cropped text could be 真打ち行こうぜ or 裏打ち行こうぜ; I translated as 真打ち行こうぜ ('the main act' / 'the real deal').
Third line: the last word could be バージョン or a misprinted パージョン; I translated it as バージョン ("Version").
Inserted the particle の in 「俺の最後のクライマックスだ」 because the scan omits it but Japanese grammar strongly implies it.
Punctuation between 「な」 and 「てめえらいいな」 was unclear in the image; rendered as 「な、てめえらいいな」 and translated as a brief "Got that, you bastards!"
The crop/OCR included an alternative ending character (瞳) but the source text reads 嘘 (lies); the final phrase is rendered here as 千の偽り万の嘘 (a thousand deceits and ten thousand lies).
The OCR missed a character; the kanji 嘘 (lie) was inferred from the provided source text.
The middle word appears in the scan as 結構 (kekkou, "pretty"), but source_text had 結平 which seems to be an OCR error; translation assumes 結構.
Second sentence uses the unusual phrase 嘘は嘘の為の嘘—translated literally as “lies for the sake of lying”; meaning may be figurative.
In the final sentence, the subject who might die is not specified in this panel; translated as “he” as the most likely referent from context, but the original does not name the person.
The second clause in the source text ends with a trailing comma and is incomplete; translation preserves the interrupted meaning as a dash.
The original Japanese line ends with '入れて' and may be truncated or continue in the next panel.
Rendering of the onomatopoeia 'ぐぉー' as 'Gwooo' is an interpretation of the sound; other English spellings (e.g., 'Gwoaa' or 'Guaa') are possible.
Original text OCR showed 「おとなしく悪いとらんで」 which is likely 「おとなしくしとらんで」 (Kansai dialect for 'aren't being quiet').
The phrase 「モモの字たち」 may be correct as printed, but could be a misreading of a similar word (e.g., モモの子たち).
'泣けるで' interpreted as the emphatic 'You'll cry' (colloquial/dialectal phrasing).
"しまらんのお" is Kansai dialect; I translated it as "it's out of control," but it could also mean "it can't be helped" or "this won't end well" depending on context.
OCR alternative read the first line as 「兄の前座だ。」(older-brother's opening act). The crop appears to show 「只の前座だ」(just the opening act).

rows.text: 台詞リスト <変身後状態>
ソードフォーム

5.translation: Listen, I don't do preambles. It's a climax from start to finish!

rows.text: いいか、俺に前振りはねえ。 最初から最後までクライマックスだ!
rows.translation: Listen, I don't do preambles. It's a climax from start to finish!

6.translation:
• Today I'll show you a special phantom technique.
• Here I go — the finishing move!

rows.text: 今日は特別に幻の技を見せてやる。 いくぜ必殺。
rows.translation: Today I'll show you a special phantom technique. Here I go — the finishing move!

7.translation: I told you, I'm the climax from start to finish!

rows.text: 言ったはずだぜ、俺は最初から最後までクライマックスだってな!
rows.translation: I told you, I'm the climax from start to finish!

8.translation: Today it's the climax for everyone — all together!

rows.text: 今日は全員まとめてクライマックスだぜ!
rows.translation: Today it's the climax for everyone — all together!

9.translation: Today's special move is a little different.

rows.text: 今日の必殺技は一味違うぜ。
rows.translation: Today's special move is a little different.

10.translation: Yeah — it means the climax all the way to the end, right?

rows.text: ああ、最後までクライマックスって意味だろ。
rows.translation: Yeah — it means the climax all the way to the end, right?

11.translation: The special move I've secretly been preparing.

rows.text: さっきからひそかに温めてた必殺技。
rows.translation: The special move I've secretly been preparing.

12.translation: This really is the very last time.

rows.text: これでほんとに、最後の最後だ。
rows.translation: This really is the very last time.

13.translation: Heh heh heh—fighting really is the best!

rows.text: へっへっへ~やっぱ戦ってるときは最高だぜ!
rows.translation: Heh heh heh—fighting really is the best!

15.translation: Alright, shall we go for the climax after a long break?

rows.text: さあて、久しぶりにクライマックスといくか。
rows.translation: Alright, shall we go for the climax after a long break?

17.translation: From here on it's a full-on climax! Let's go, let's go, let's go!

rows.text: こっからは徹底的にクライマックスだからな!いくぜいくぜいくぜー!
rows.translation: From here on it's a full-on climax! Let's go, let's go, let's go!

18.translation: Listen up, you something-bastard — today I'm already at the climax before it even begins.

rows.text: いいか何とか野郎、今日の俺は始まる前からクライマックスだぜ。
rows.translation: Listen up, you something-bastard — today I'm already at the climax before it even begins.

19.translation: What do you mean "hmph"? Don't make fun of me! 1-2-3-5-6-7-8-9-10!

rows.translation: What do you mean "hmph"? Don't make fun of me! 1-2-3-5-6-7-8-9-10!

20.translation:
• You guys, let's go!
• Alright!
• Yes—this is gonna be moving!
• Yay!
• Huh?... Hmph.

rows.text: お前ら行くぜ!いいよ! よっしゃ、泣けるで! イェイ! ん?...フン。
rows.translation: You guys, let's go! Alright! Yes—this is gonna be moving! Yay! Huh?... Hmph.

rows.text: ロッドフォーム
台詞一覧

24.translation: Do not chase a fish that got away too far.

rows.text: 逃げた魚は深追い禁止だね。
rows.translation: Do not chase a fish that got away too far.

25.translation: Shall I split it into three pieces soon?

rows.text: そろそろ3枚に卸すか。
rows.translation: Shall I split it into three pieces soon?

26.translation: Fishing in a place like this isn't my hobby.

rows.text: こういう場所での釣りは、趣味じゃないな。
rows.translation: Fishing in a place like this isn't my hobby.

27.translation: The fish you catch just look bigger...isn't that all there is?

rows.text: 釣った魚はデカく見える・・・だけじゃないか。
rows.translation: The fish you catch just look bigger...isn't that all there is?

rows.text: そろそろ締めますか。

29.translation: You don't want to lose prey once you've almost reeled it in.

rows.text: 一度釣り上げかけた獲物は、逃がしたくないんだよね。
rows.translation: You don't want to lose prey once you've almost reeled it in.

30.translation: I'm not like a peach that's hollow inside.

rows.text: 僕は中身スカスカのモモとは違うよ。
rows.translation: I'm not like a peach that's hollow inside.

31.translation: Looks like those guys are the ones who need to be punished.

rows.text: おしおきしなきゃいけないのは、あいつらの方らしいね。
rows.translation: Looks like those guys are the ones who need to be punished.

33.translation: All right, shall we wrap things up soon?

rows.text: さあ、そろそろ始めようか。
rows.translation: All right, shall we wrap things up soon?

34.translation: I won't let you get away.

rows.text: 逃がさないよ。
rows.translation: I won't let you get away.

rows.text: アックスフォーム

38.translation: Make me angrier! That gets me more fired up!

rows.text: もっと俺を怒らせろ! そのほうが燃えてくるで!
rows.translation: Make me angrier! That gets me more fired up!

rows.text: ごっつあんです!

42.translation: All right, here I go! My strength will make you cry!

rows.text: さあ行くで! 俺の強さは、泣けるで!
rows.translation: All right, here I go! My strength will make you cry!

rows.text: よっしゃ! どすこい!
ガンフォーム
台詞一覧

48.translation: You're pretty funny. Do more of that.

rows.text: お前結構面白いね。 もっとやってよ。
rows.translation: You're pretty funny. Do more of that.

49.translation:
• You're in the way.
• Can I erase you?
• I'm not asking for your answer.

rows.text: お前邪魔。 消してもいい? 答えは聞いてない。
rows.translation: You're in the way. Can I erase you? I'm not asking for your answer.

50.translation: Ugh, I hate being interrupted. It's not fun anymore.

rows.text: あーもう、邪魔されるの嫌い。 面白くなくなっちゃった。
rows.translation: Ugh, I hate being interrupted. It's not fun anymore.

rows.text: お前つまんない。
ガキじゃないよ!
ばーん!

54.translation:
• This hurts, but it's okay, right?
• I'm not asking for an answer!

rows.text: これ痛いけどいいよね? 答えは聞いてない!
rows.translation: This hurts, but it's okay, right? I'm not asking for an answer!

rows.text: 僕の勝ちだね。

56.translation: Okay, I'll go from this side! Bam!

rows.text: じゃあこっちから行くよ! ばーん!
rows.translation: Okay, I'll go from this side! Bam!

rows.text: ネガ電王
台詞一覧

59.translation: Its strength is in a class of its own.

rows.text: 強さは、別格だ。
rows.translation: Its strength is in a class of its own.

rows.text: ぶっ潰す!

61.translation: You're the one who's going down.

rows.text: 倒されるのはてめえだぜ。
rows.translation: You're the one who's going down.

rows.text: トドメだ!

63.translation: Damn it... My evil organization will never be defeated!

rows.text: くっそぉ...。 俺様の悪の組織は、絶対に負けねえ!
rows.translation: Damn it... My evil organization will never be defeated!

64.translation: The evil organization is... eternal... Aaaah!

rows.text: 悪の組織は･･･永遠・・・ああああ!
rows.translation: The evil organization is... eternal... Aaaah!

69.translation: 1 Here comes the finale. Okay? I'm not asking for your answer.

rows.text: 1 最後行くよ。 いい? 答えは聞いてない。
rows.translation: 1 Here comes the finale. Okay? I'm not asking for your answer.

• For details, see the CSM Dengasher instruction manual.

blocks.translation: Sword Form transformation in Episode 4 (Dialogue Mode only)

赤スイッチを長押しします。

blocks.translation: Transform to Climax Form by Pass Touch

blocks.text:
①ベルト(右)が外れた状態で
ケータロスを装着します。
ベルト本体から「着脱音」が鳴り、
LEDが発光します。
②必殺ボタンを短押しすると、
ケータロス側が
「台詞モード」の場合、
下記音声が順番に鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
① With the belt (right) detached, attach the Ketaros. The belt unit will play the “attach/detach” sound and the LED will light.
② Short-press the finisher button; if the Ketaros is set to “Line Mode,” the following voice lines will play in order.

blocks.text: 音声

モモタロス 「俺、参上! あー痛ってててて。ったく、死ぬかと思ったぜ。」
モモタロス 「馬鹿野郎。 俺達がどんだけ一緒にいたと思ってんだ。
いいか、今から本当の変身ってやつを見せてやる。」
blocks.translation:
• Momotaros: I'm here! Ow, ow, ow. Damn, I thought I was going to die.
• Momotaros: You idiot. Do you have any idea how long we've been together? Listen, I'm going to show you a real transformation now.

blocks.text:

blocks.translation:
• If the Den-O Belt main unit is set to “No dialog mode,” pressing the finisher button plays “Climax” and cancels the <Rider Form standby state> setting described on p.21.
• If the unit is in “Dialog mode,” playing the dialog voice above also cancels the <Rider Form standby state>.

blocks.text:

blocks.translation:

② If the Ketaros side is in “Line Mode” and you press the finisher button during the transformation standby sound, the Imagins will say, “I’ve been waiting! Shall we go? Yay! Long time no see! Transform!”

blocks.text:
クライマックスフォーム変身待機音が鳴っている間に、ライダーパスをケータロスの画面部分に近づけます。
「クライマックスフォーム変身音(さらば電王ver.)」が鳴り、「台詞モード」の場合は続けて
イマジンズ 「わーい懐かしー! でもやっぱり気持ち悪い。 うるせえ! 一発で決めるぜ!よっしゃー! いつでもどうぞ!」が鳴ります。
